description: Alberto Gatto and colleagues at Politecnico di Milano publish simulation results for a coherent optical detector developed in the PASSION project. The calculations evaluate receiver performance as local-oscillator frequency drift, finite laser linewidth and photodiode electrical bandwidth change. The source describes a received signal generated by direct discrete-multitone modulation of a short-cavity long-wavelength vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser. Zenodo lists an XLSX workbook for photodiode-bandwidth results and a DOCX document for linewidth and frequency-deviation results. Both are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. This is a simulation-output dataset for communication-component performance. The related PASSION WDM-planning record concerns network design; no direct data dependency is asserted. A limitation is that the source description does not enumerate parameter ranges, output units, numerical resolution or validation evidence. These are simulated component responses, and the metadata does not establish performance of an operating optical network.
